design_philosophy: Industrial Swiss Brutalism. Emphasizes raw geometric precision, full-bleed rectangles, and stark contrast to reflect the exact engineering of machinery. No rounded corners. Thick borders, grid-like structure, and technical layout prioritized over decorative fluff. Language strictly German.

headings.usage: Heavy, authoritative text. No Inter for headings.

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento 'Control Room' for specs, and 'Tetris' for marketing hero sections. Use wide gaps for hero (gap-8), tight gaps for specs (gap-4).
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous paddings (p-6, p-8, p-12) within stark bordered containers.
layout_and_spacing.borders: border-collapse styles. 1px or 2px solid black/gray lines outlining structural grids.
layout_and_spacing.shadows: No soft shadows. Use hard 4px offset solid shadows (Neo-brutalist) or no shadow at all. Pure functional flat design.

components.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none). Primary buttons use Signal Red (#FF3B30) background with stark white text. Hover states increase brightness and add a 1px inner stroke.
components.cards: Flat background, 1px solid border (border-border), rounded-none, no shadow. Hover: border darkens to black.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Form primitives. Sharp inputs (rounded-none), thick borders on focus. Strict invoice/bank transfer fields.
components.navigation: Solid white background, sticky nav with thick bottom border. Hamburger on mobile, fully visible links on desktop.

home_catalog.hero: Full bleed rectangular hero image with sharp black overlay (bg-black/40). Heavy H1 on the left. Primary CTA: 'Maschinen ansehen' or 'Angebot anfragen'.
home_catalog.filters: Left sidebar or top bar with stark rectangular dropdowns (Shadcn Select). Filters: Kategorie, Preis.
home_catalog.grid: CSS Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3). Each product cell has a hard border.

product_detail.layout: Split screen: massive product image on the left, technical specs and Add to Cart on the right. 'Angebotsanfrage' (Quote Request) button next to Add to Cart.
product_detail.specs: Use tables or grid borders to list technical details.

cart_and_checkout.cart: Slide-out or dedicated page with clear table of items.
cart_and_checkout.checkout: Single page form. No account creation. Payment method strictly labeled 'Rechnung / Überweisung' (Invoice / Bank Transfer).

contact.layout: Grid split with a large form on one side and company contact details on the other.

hero.description: Industrial workshop with machinery and large windows, used as main hero background.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, links must include `data-testid` (e.g., `data-testid="add-to-cart-button"`).

language: Deutsch (German) strictly. E.g., Warenkorb, Kasse, Angebot anfragen, In den Warenkorb, Kaufen.
